comment: Idle loop for the Triceratops rig (scripts/blender/animate_idle.py). Seconds and degrees about the body's axes (axes: armature): +yaw toward the animal's left, -pitch raises. Small, slow movements; no jaw (the beak is closed).
name: Idle

breathing.comment: Rib cage widens and deepens on the inhale; spine3 takes the inverse scale so the neck, head and front legs keep their size and place.

look.comment: Total neck + head turn, shared between bones by weight. Keys are [time, yaw, pitch], eased between. Spine bones are left out so the front feet stay planted.

tail.comment: A slow side-to-side wave that travels toward the tip, with a small lift twice per loop.
